formal_scope: Complete fp32 DQ helper and sequential DQ/barrier/DK/DV helper expansion after caller index specialization; arbitrary source-model dimensions, strides, initial states and aliases. No native, host sum or multi-program theorem.
formal_surface: Backend-parametric source execution and independent input-memory recurrence, with complete memory equality. M and D are explicit parameters; no final-output equality or floating algebraic law is a premise.

obligations.relation: Bind M.unary fp32 exp2/log2 at every decay site to the exact compiler/libdevice graph. Head decay is log2(sub32(1,exp2(sub32(-5,mul32(fromNat(head),1))))).
cases: signed diagonal differences including eager masked lanes
row/block decay and log2 argument near one
obligations.required_evidence: Raw argument/result words, exact instruction/IR and library hashes, GPU/compiler/driver, FTZ and fusion options; whole outputs separately. An approximation policy must be specified before evaluating samples.

obligations.relation: Source D.apply retains allow_tf32=false and two-argument dot followed by a separate accumulator add. Native live-carry dot/FMA must have its own recurrence; source dot-from-zero plus add is not assumed equal to dotAcc.
obligations.required_evidence: Actual reduction/FMA order, input/accumulator precision, zero seed, scale/cast sites and raw intermediate/output words. Reuse v2 compiled observations only as graph evidence, not execution success.

obligations.relation: Bind M.binary, M.literal, M.cast, M.fromNat/M.fromInt and fp32Load. Preserve dq*(rowDecay*scale) between loops and (dot*diagonalDecay)*scale inside the diagonal loop, including the source casts.
obligations.required_evidence: Per-site source-to-IR map and words; do not use distributivity, reassociation, exact real transcendental functions or cast=id to bridge mismatches.

obligations.relation: Boundary loads have no padding_option. The source uses address-indexed s.undef, never an assumed zero. Relate native undefined/poison behavior to that model explicitly.
obligations.required_evidence: Load descriptors and inactive-lane policy plus output captures. Guard-buffer bytes do not measure an undefined register, and finite repeatability is not a nondeterminism proof.

obligations.relation: Relate unbounded Nat addresses and widened signed differences to actual source integer widths, physical byte storage, legal allocations and launch indices. Zero-step source semantics is not a legal native launch guarantee.
cases: boundary integer values without invalid GPU accesses
obligations.required_evidence: Document native width/range preconditions, ABI, grid and allocated spans; do not silently strengthen existing source-model theorems.

obligations.relation: The source expansion executes DQ then barrier then DK/DV; later references read post-DQ memory. Relate native helper inlining, barrier behavior, aliases and cross-program order to the source before claiming kernel correctness.
cases: all DQ/DK/DV partial outputs and frames
obligations.required_evidence: Full input/output memory words, helper call identities and launch metadata. Source-level arbitrary aliases do not assert native race freedom.

obligations.relation: PyTorch sums of partial outputs across NK/NV, dtype conversion, host allocation and autograd dispatch require separate models and proofs.
obligations.required_evidence: First specify the host reduction tree/order and dtype behavior, then collect raw partial and summed words. Capturing host outputs does not extend the helper theorem.
